# URL allowlist for the Copilot CLI preToolUse hook.
# One domain per line. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# A request to host H is allowed if H equals an entry, or H ends with
# ".<entry>" (i.e. the entry matches on a dot boundary, so "github.com"
# allows "api.github.com" but not "evilgithub.com").

github.com
docs.github.com
api.github.com
raw.githubusercontent.com
objects.githubusercontent.com
pkg.go.dev
registry.npmjs.org
pypi.org
